name: Integrity
vision_statement: Every part of the runner is a specified solution whose best implementation runs as the state of the art moves.
opportunities: A repository that specifies every part as a solution with alternatives and a metric lets the best implementation run as models and tools change. That is a space beyond the engine the top intent describes: the structure check and the selector belong to the esoi library, but QAR measures whether its assistant behaves by the structure, scores how much of its wiring is configuration and not code, keeps its tests runnable offline and its public code free of secrets, and loads one configuration per lane.
solution_coherence: Integrity keeps every part of the runner a specified solution whose best implementation runs, so the package, its front door, its configuration and its offline checks stay one measured whole.
